$comment: Seasonal weekdays (L-068), proper of time: Advent weeks 1-3, Ash Wednesday to Wednesday of Holy Week (Ash Wednesday and the days after it are week 0; Holy Week is week 6), Easter weeks 2-7. Imported from LitCal (import/litcal/seasonal-weekdays.json); Thursday of Lent week 1 and Monday of Lent week 3 are filled from the OLM 1981 structure because their LitCal strings do not parse (Greek Esther lettered chapter; two psalms in one string). Greek Esther cannot be keyed yet, so that first reading's ref is Est 4:17 and the OLM verses are kept in "printed". Every entry is provisional until checked against the Kenyan Lectionary (docs/decisions/011-lectionary-source.md).
